title: Prevent generation sample-budget estimator overflow
description: Seven-seat whole-codebase audit found that GenerationSettings.EstimateSampleCount could overflow before its saturating product: a cell count at long.MaxValue was incremented directly, wrapping negative and potentially bypassing the validator's allocation budget. Harden the shared estimator with saturating per-axis increments and retain exact behavior for ordinary grids. Add a boundary regression using an extreme finite bound.

comments.author: council-seven-seat-audit
comments.body: Implemented in GenerationSettings.EstimateSampleCount with SaturatingIncrement. Added GenerationSettingsTests.EstimateSampleCount_SaturatesWhenCellCountReachesLongMaxValue. No automated or Unity execution was performed in this campaign.
